items.text: A career after BSc BEd mainly leads to school teaching in government or private schools, with options in coaching, edtech content, curriculum design and training, and eligibility tests, state rules and school type shape pay and postings.
Check eligibility tests and state rules for the school type you want, build a teaching portfolio and keep a second route such as content or training.
Verify on official notices and never pay agents for posts.
